name: use-auto-save
title: useAutoSave
description: Configuration options for the useAutoSave hook.

tags.template: - The keys of T to exclude from the save payload.

types.name: BaseConfig
types.description: Configuration options for the useAutoSave hook.

properties.name: delay
properties.description: The debounce delay in milliseconds before triggering the onSave callback.

parameters.name: initialData
parameters.description: - The initial state of the data object.

parameters.name: onSave
parameters.description: - The async function to call when data changes. Receives the clean data payload.

returnType.name: UseAutoSaveReturn<T>
returnType.description: Object containing data, setters, and saving state.

properties.name: data
properties.description: The current state of the data.

properties.name: setData
properties.description: Standard React state setter for the data.

properties.name: onChange
properties.description:
A smart change handler factory.
Can be used with standard inputs `onChange("name")` or direct values `onChange("age")(30)`.

properties.name: isSaving
properties.description: Indicates if a save operation is currently in progress.
